name: Martin Adenauer
original_name: マルティン・アデナウアー
source:
Kia's client.

He is a corrupt real estate baron who is trying to chase the people from the downtown area, buy up their property dirt-cheap, and sell it to big businesses for a major profit. However, he has met resistance from Dirk and his friends.

[From in-game profile]
